==Usage==
This template is to be used for issues of ''[[Star Wars Starships & Vehicles]]''. Place the following code on the page and replace the "issue number," the "department," and the "article" with the appropriate information.
<nowiki>{{</nowiki>ShipsandVehiclesCite|ISSUE NUMBER|DEPARTMENT}}

'''Note''': formatted subtitles for each department are defined in [[Module:FormattedTextLookup/RefMagazine]], and do not need to be included in usages of the template. Departments for new issues should be added there.

This template, like the rest of the reference magazine citation templates, is built using [[Module:BaseCitation]]. See [[Module:BaseCitation/doc]] for relevant maintenance categories and help building new templates. 

==Examples==
<code><nowiki>{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|1|History of the Ship}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|1|History of the Ship}}

[[Category:Reference magazine citation templates|ShipsandVehiclesCite]]</noinclude>
